title: 3X PCR Replicate Pooling
author: Rodolfo A Salido Benitez
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ue8ethw
materials: If needed, thaw PCR plates, then centrifuge them.

steps.title: Set up epMotion worktable
steps.instruction: Using the epMotion 5075 liquid handler (Eppendorf, catalog 5075000962), follow the provided diagram to arrange the deck:

substeps.instruction: Place four (4) boxes of 1‑50 µL epTIPS with filter on slots A3‑A4 and B3‑B4 respectively.
Place the PCR plates on slots A2, B2, and C2.
Confirm epBlue software version 40.6 or later is installed.
Import the file named “Application_3X_pooling_3‑384 to 1‑384_181003_105035.export6” into epBlue.

steps.title: Remove lids and foils
steps.instruction: Take off the lids from the tip boxes and the foil seals from all PCR plates.

steps.title: Execute pooling protocol
steps.instruction: Run the imported protocol; it uses the multiaspirate feature to pool PCR products:

substeps.instruction: Aspirate 7 µL from each well of plates PCR1 and PCR2 (air may be aspirated).
Dispense the combined volume into the corresponding well of plate PCR3.
